# Ribbon Shift

Ribbon Shift is an original toroidal-strip spatial puzzle. Restore each three-by-three woven mosaic by cycling a complete row right or a complete column down; every shift wraps around the edge.

Use Left/Right to focus one of six ribbon handles and Space to shift it. On touch screens, tap a board row or its coral arrow to move that row right, or tap a mint arrow below the board to move its column down.

The game uses deterministic seeded boards. The three mosaics have exact shortest solution depths of 2, 3, and 4 shifts, with both row and column moves required in a shortest route. Replay returns to the same deterministic weave. Score and device-local practice best are supplied by GameKit.

# Ribbon Shift

Ribbon Shift is an original toroidal-strip spatial puzzle. Restore three woven 3×3 mosaics by moving a whole row right or a whole column down. Every shift wraps at the far edge; tiles never merge.

Use Left and Right to choose one of the six handles, then press Space to shift that strip. On touch screens, tap any row (or its right arrow) to move that row right, or tap a bottom arrow to move its column down.

Each deterministic seed creates three solvable boards with exact shortest solution depths of two, three, and four moves. Every selected shortest route uses both row and column shifts. Replay returns to the same seeded weave. Current score and device-local practice best are supplied by GameKit.

tests: Load the page at 390px, 768px, and 1280px widths and verify the start control, goal progress, canvas, and local-best labels are visible.
For seed 23, inspect RibbonShiftCore.create(23) and verify board has nine values 0 through 8, cursor is 0, moves is 0, and stage is 0.
Use independently discovered legal shifts to solve all three boards; verify solved progresses 0/3 through 3/3 and completion does not terminal before tick 900.
Tap a row region and a bottom-column region once each and verify moves increments once per discrete pointer contact.
Toggle reduced-motion preference and verify RibbonPresentation.snapshot().particles is zero while reduced motion is active.
result.summary: Repaired Ribbon Shift with bounded deterministic board generation, exact mixed-axis shortest-depth candidates, resilient canvas drawing, live reduced-motion reporting, and corrected result/goal DOM wiring.
